title: Chapter frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter at the top of every file in content/. Each field becomes a data-* attribute the engine reads.

id.description: Permanent, lowercase, hyphenated. Also the file name and the URL. Never change it; if you must, add the old id to data/aliases.json.

order.description: Position inside the book, such as "9.2". A quoted string, so "9.10" stays 9.10. Insert between two chapters with a third part, such as "9.2.1".

stability.description: How fast the facts go stale. Sets the review schedule: volatile after 3 months, moving after 6, evergreen after 12.

reviewed.description: Year and month of the last full review, quoted, such as "2026-11".

status.description: seed: TL;DR, key ideas and planned visuals only. full: the complete chapter template.

visuals.description: Every visual in the body, as "visual-id:form". The form is the viz component, or the Mermaid diagram type (flowchart, sequence, state and so on).
